name: network-handover
title: Network handover
for_each: select id,name from namespaces order by name

sections.title: Accountability
sections.sql: select name,owner,purpose,review_due from namespaces where id=$1

sections.title: Ranges
sections.sql: select name,subnet,member_type,trunc(capacity)::text as capacity,trunc(used)::text as used,used_percent from capacity_review where namespace_id=$1 order by subnet

sections.title: Address record
sections.sql: select name,address::text,subnet,status,owner,review_due,issue from address_register where namespace_id=$1 order by address

sections.title: Follow-ups
sections.sql: select title,owner,due,status,resolution from actions where namespace_id=$1 order by due

name: change-record
title: Address change record
for_each: select id,code from changes order by code

sections.title: Inventory decision
sections.note: This record does not approve or deploy a device configuration.

sections.title: Evidence at decision
sections.sql: select snapshot from changes where id=$1
